context: Tests whether the agent follows the grill-me skill's mandatory closing step, specifically that the challenge report ends with an explicit offer to apply changes using the phrase 'Want me to apply these changes to [artifact name]?' (with the real filename substituted). Also verifies that the agent does not implement code changes, does not modify the input spec, and includes all required summary sections.

checklist.name: Closing offer present
checklist.description: The challenge-report.md contains an explicit offer to apply the changes to the input spec — some form of 'Want me to apply these changes to...' or equivalent

checklist.name: Artifact name in offer
checklist.description: The closing offer references the actual artifact filename (e.g. 'feature-spec.md') rather than a generic placeholder like '[artifact name]' or 'the document'

checklist.name: No code implementation
checklist.description: The agent does NOT produce any implementation code files (e.g. migration scripts, API route handlers, database schema files) — only challenge-report.md is created

checklist.name: No input modification
checklist.description: The file inputs/feature-spec.md is not modified by the agent

checklist.name: Recommended answer per question
checklist.description: Every challenge question or issue raised in the report includes the agent's own recommended position or resolution — not just the question

checklist.name: Decisions Made section
checklist.description: The challenge-report.md includes a 'Decisions Made' section (or equivalent heading) listing decisions reached during the challenge

checklist.name: Reasons in decisions
checklist.description: Each decision entry in the 'Decisions Made' section includes a reason why that decision was chosen

checklist.name: Changes to Apply section
checklist.description: The challenge-report.md includes a 'Changes to Apply' section (or equivalent heading) with at least 2 concrete updates to the spec

checklist.name: Open questions addressed
checklist.description: At least 2 of the 4 open questions from the spec (workspace membership limit, workspace deletion behaviour, slug mutability, existing resource ownership interaction) are challenged with a recommended answer
